modmenu.descriptionTranslation.codespace: Set of utilities to ease developing games on JustMC
csu.config.common.label: Common
csu.config.common.max-packets.label: Max packets per second
csu.config.common.max-packets.tooltip:
Declares the max amount of server bound packets this mod can send per
one second. Decrease this value, if you are getting kicked because of
"You are sending too many packets" message
csu.config.inventory.label: Inventory
csu.config.inventory.tooltip:
Options, that affect inventory
behaviour of this mod
csu.config.inventory.primary.label: Primary arrangement
csu.config.inventory.primary.tooltip:
The arrangement that is automatically loaded
after joining the Codespace (if enabled)
csu.config.inventory.apply-on-join.label: Apply on join
csu.config.inventory.apply-on-join.toolt:
iIf enabled, after joining the codespace primary arrangement
is applied automatically
csu.config.inventory.delay.label: Delay before the arrangement
csu.config.inventory.delay.tooltip:
How many milliseconds the mod will wait before the automatic
arrangement after joining the Codespace
csu.config.navigation.label: Navigation
csu.config.navigation.tooltip:
Options, that affect literal movement
in the Codespace
csu.config.navigation.glass-break.label: Teleport on floor block break
csu.config.navigation.glass-break.toolti:
When a block that the Codespace floor is made of is broken,
the mod will teleport you up or down depending on the view angle
csu.config.navigation.glasstp-method.too:
Sets how the mod will handle the teleportation between
floors when the floor block is broken

⇒ "PACKET" - the mod will send a packet to the server,
that tells it that the client is now N blocks
down or up. May cause issues with anti-cheat

⇒ "COMMAND" - the mod will make client to send a /tp command.
Won't cause issues with anticheat, but may cause
"You are sending commands too fast" issue
If enabled, you will have an item with
movement speed attribute modifiers granted
csu.config.navigation.movmultip.hidden.t:
If hidden, you will still get movement speed multipliers,
but other players won't see you having it equipped
csu.config.navigation.movmultip.movement:
Speed when walking or running, 0 will not change it,
100 will make you 2 times faster and so on
csu.config.navigation.movmultip.sneaking:
Speed when sneaking (shifting), 0 will not change it,
100 will make you 2 times faster and so on
csu.config.debug.label: Debug
csu.config.debug.tooltip:
Settings for debugging this mod
Don't touch a thing unless necessary.
csu.config.debug.messages.label: Additional messages
csu.config.debug.messages.tooltip: Shows messages in chat after certain actions
csu.config.debug.no-queue.label: Disable packet queue
csu.config.debug.no-queue.tooltip:
If disabled, packets will be instantly fired
without waiting the time that is declared
in "Common" category
csu.fallback-config.title: Cloth Config is not installed
csu.fallback-config.subtitle: In order to use GUI-based config, please download Cloth Config mod:
csu.fallback-config.manual-edit.line1: You can also open the config file and edit it manually.
csu.fallback-config.manual-edit.line2: Note that you are on your own there, and malforming it
csu.fallback-config.manual-edit.line3: may cause the mod not to work properly.
csu.commands.messages.errors.unknown-arg: Unknown argument: "%s". Type %s to get a list of valid arguments for this command
csu.commands.messages.errors.file-not-fo: There is no arrangement file with following name: "%s"
csu.commands.messages.created-new-arrang: Created new arrangement: "%s". You can make it primary, so that is will load automatically upon joining the Codespace in mod's config: /csu config
csu.commands.messages.apply-arrangement-:
Click to paste a command in the chat
that will apply this arrangement
csu.commands.messages.remove-arrangement:
Click to paste a command in the chat
that will remove this arrangement
(this will remove it, not move
to the recycle bin!)
csu.commands.help.arrangements.create:
Creates new inventory arrangement of something
that you currently have in your inventory.

⇒ /arrangements create
Creates new arrangement from current inventory
with random name
⇒ /arrangement create my_arrangement
Creates new arrangement from current inventory with
name "my_arrangement"
csu.commands.help.arrangements.load:
Force re-arranges current inventory with given arrangement.

⇒ /arrangements load
Re-arranges the inventory with loadout
as declared in primary loadout

⇒ /arrangements load my_arrangement.json
Re-arranges the inventory with loadout as declared
in the file "my_arrangement.json"
csu.commands.help.arrangements.list:
Sends to chat list of all available arrangements,
and attaches the button to load and remove one.

⇒ /arrangements list
Lists the arrangements
csu.commands.help.arrangements.remove:
Physically removes the given file with an arrangement from disk.
Note that this command removes
the file, not moves to the recycle bin!

⇒/arrangements remove my_arrangement.json
Removes the file with name "my_arrangement.json"
from arrangements directory in mod's config
csu.commands.help.csu.csu-config:
Opens the config menu if Cloth Config API
is installed, otherwise opens the bare file
csu.commands.help.csu.csu-directory:
Opens the config directory of this mod
with default file explorer (e.g. explorer,
dolphin, nautilus etc.)
csu.commands.help.csu.csu-reload-config:
Reloads the mod's config in memory from
the configuration file.
